prompt:
An electric kettle receives an electrical power input of 2.4 kW. When boiling water, the rate at which thermal energy is usefully transferred to the water is 1.92 kW.
(a) Calculate the efficiency of the kettle as a percentage. [1]
(b) State the rate at which energy is dissipated to the surroundings. [1]
hints: In (a), divide useful power by total power and multiply by 100%.
In (b), subtract useful power from total input power.
solution:
(a) Efficiency = (P_useful / P_in) * 100% = (1.92 kW / 2.4 kW) * 100% = 0.80 * 100% = 80%.
(b) Rate of energy dissipation = P_in - P_useful = 2.4 kW - 1.92 kW = 0.48 kW (480 W).
teacher_walkthrough: Direct one-step drill on power formulation of efficiency.
Verify student includes correct units in (b) (either kW or W).
